title: Metric interaction edges with a retained world anchor
coverage_gap: D5 contains three LL and two HH episodes but no LH or HL. Stick x and goal y are confounded, and normalizing nearly fixed coordinates by tiny support standard deviations can magnify extrapolation. No failed grasp recovery is demonstrated.
reusable_regularity: Expose signed hand-to-stick, stick-to-pushed-object, and pushed-object-to-goal edges directly in world axes. Use centimeter-scale motion and grasp features but decimeter-scale scene features, rather than forcing the denoiser to subtract independently standardized positions. Two full observations and each native previous pose are retained. This is an explicit nonlearned representation, not a controller or a phase rule.
dependencies_preserved: World-aligned vectors, absolute heights, and stick position relative to a fixed support-fit world origin preserve table/gravity, workspace, and fixed native hand orientation dependencies; no rotational or translational task symmetry is assumed.
The origin is the mean initial object2_xyz across only these five support episodes, restored in deployment state. Given this origin and the edge vectors, all input point positions remain recoverable.

Current and previous hand, stick, and pushed-object motion, gripper aperture/change, and both object orientations are present. Zero object2 quaternion remains zero; only the physical quaternion double cover is canonicalized.

Goal is the declared goal_xyz, not an inferred reward location. Object2 is the declared insertion-site-plus-[0,.09,0] point; no unobserved contact location or obstacle state is substituted. Fixed scene dependencies are retained through absolute geometry.

evidence_refs.detail: Exactly five current support episodes, images_and_numeric evidence.
39D observation sources, object COM/site conventions, 80Hz native world action4 and LL/HH coverage.
LL=3, HH=2; native action y variation is small compared with x/z; object2 quaternion channels are zero in support.
Read obs 0:4, 23:29, 48:52, 72:75 and actions 0:20, 25:45, 45:60. Hand descends near the stick, aperture closes, stick rises, then object2 translates in +x.
Visible initial robot, tabletop stick and pushed assembly.
Visible translated pushed assembly at late demonstration.
Fixed factory/condition/action and mask contract; no change to common DP loss.

expected_failure_signature: If explicit metric edges do not break the support correlation, grasp alignment error will vary with target y even when stick pose is matched.

A representation-only model may average the abrupt descending-to-lifting transition, close or lift too soon, or continue a pushing motion after losing the tool. It has neither learned phase supervision nor future-effect consistency.
Orientation departures and contacts far beyond support may still fail; world dependencies are preserved, not modeled by a planner. These are predictions, not measured results.

required_runtime_fields.raw_history: [B,2,39], every declared position/aperture/quaternion in current18 and previous18 plus goal_xyz
required_runtime_fields.support_fit_state: world_origin: mean of D5 obs[0,11:14] only
required_runtime_fields.action_frame: Identity encode/decode: world_dx, world_dy, world_dz in native 0.01m action units and unchanged scalar gripper. Host-only native cube clipping; fixed chunk16/executed4.

change_summary: Initial A1 authored from this bundle: a 65D metric relational condition, one unchanged common U-Net, no learned side modules or auxiliary loss. No performance information was available.
